[SWS_DM_00387] Ignoring UDS message reception because DM has no (memory) ressources
⌈
If the DM is not able to process the indicated UDS request,
because it has not enough (memory) resources to hold the indicated UDS request, it
shall return a std::pair with IndicationResult set to kIndicationOverflow
and a UdsMessagePtr equal to UdsMessagePtr(nullptr).
⌋
